_comment: UK channels follow the rights split in generate.py (England -> ITV; Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland -> BBC, Wales also on S4C). Add a per-match exception here, keyed by the match id in data/matches.json - e.g. the June 2027 final once its UK broadcaster is announced: {"uk": "ITV"}, or {"uk": "BBC", "detail": "BBC One / iPlayer"}. {"uk": ""} drops a match from the calendar.
